castTime.binNote: 0.375s cast time applies only to the enemy-targeted cast; the self-cast has no cast time (bin has no separate data value for either).

values.binNote: The bin's HealAmount formula (SelfCastFlatHeal + 0.55xap) is the total heal at 0% missing health; the wiki's per-tick minimum is that total divided by 10 ticks (0.25s interval over the 2.5s stasis).

values.quote: herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration
values.binNote: The bin models the heal as a single total (LissandraR#HealAmount) with no explicit tick-interval data value; the 0.25s interval is only stated in the wiki description text.

mechanics.claim: The self-cast heal is increased based on missing health at the moment of casting, up to double at 100% missing health.
mechanics.quote: The healing is increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''missing''' health at the time of cast|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of '''missing''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit by the ice field can only be damaged once every 4 seconds, so under normal use it hits an enemy only once per cast.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can only be damaged by the field of ice once every 4 seconds.

mechanics.claim: If the enemy target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away during the cast time, the enemy-cast ability cancels without going on cooldown or paying its cost.
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on {{sti|cooldown}} nor pay its cost.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the single-target enemy-cast portion and the radiating ice damage, but does not stop the ice field from spreading.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the single-targeted portion and the radiating ice damage, but will not stop it from spreading.

mechanics.claim: The self-cast puts Lissandra into stasis, making her untargetable/invulnerable for its duration.
